findings.message: The client-supplied `client_name` is interpolated into a shell command run with `shell=True`. A name such as `x; rm -rf ~` executes arbitrary commands on the server.
findings.suggestion: subprocess.run(["convert", str(UPLOAD_DIR / client_name), "-resize", "128x128", str(UPLOAD_DIR / target)], check=True)

findings.message: `client_name` is never validated, so values containing `/` or `..` make ImageMagick read files outside `UPLOAD_DIR`. The same values make it write the thumbnail outside `UPLOAD_DIR`. Resolve the path and reject anything that is not a plain file name inside `UPLOAD_DIR`.
This adds new behaviour (thumbnail generation) without any test. The contributing rules require a test for every change in behaviour.
